items.why: Citi raised its price target to 800 and Mizuho to 705, citing AI chip demand. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase chip supply in 2027 as demand keeps outpacing supply.
Melius Research upgraded Microsoft to Buy with a 665 target, citing rising demand for its security and Azure offerings as AI concerns grow.
Riding the broad megacap AI rally; the Magnificent Seven hit a record 24.8 trillion combined market cap Monday as the Nasdaq notched its 23rd record high of 2026.
WTI slipped as Middle East crude exports recovered and the G-7 agreed to release 100 million barrels from emergency stockpiles, easing supply fears even as Gulf tensions persist.

market_note: Futures are green across the board; VIX down and the 10-year yield off its 24-year high, so the tone stays risk-on.
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are touching record highs, powered by AI stocks and a pullback in oil and bond yields. Risk appetite is strong even with bond market jitters in the background.
